senses.gloss: Ar., (אַדְרָא ed.) m. (√אד, v. אָדַר, cmp. חד, חדר, חדק &c.) fish-bone sticking in the throat.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 67a:6">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>לא׳ וכ׳</he> against a fish-bone in the throat, say this spell. [For <he>דד</he> a. <he>דר</he> cmp. <cite ref="A00556"><he>אודדא</he></cite>.]
